# 123 Homeschool 4 Me

> > 123 Homeschool 4 Me provides over 1 million free K-12 worksheets, educational activities, and hands-on learning resources for homeschooling families.

Founded by Beth Gorden, 123 Homeschool 4 Me is a comprehensive homeschool resource platform offering free printable worksheets, science experiments, educational games, and activities across all grade levels from preschool through high school. The site also includes practical resources like family recipes and homeschooling guides to support the complete educational journey.

## Key Topics

- Free Printables
- Math Worksheets
- Elementary Education
- Homeschool Resources
- Science Experiments

- Science Activities

- Homeschooling Guide

- [3rd Grade Worksheets and Games](https://www.123homeschool4me.com/3rd-grade-worksheets): 300,000+ 3rd grade worksheets and games for math, spelling, science
- [4th Grade Worksheets, Games, & Activities](https://www.123homeschool4me.com/4th-grade-worksheets): Free 4th grade worksheets, games, and activities for all core subjects
- [5th Grade Worksheets](https://www.123homeschool4me.com/5th-grade-worksheets): 200,000+ 5th grade worksheets and games for math, literacy, history, science
- [6th Grade Worksheets](https://www.123homeschool4me.com/6th-grade-worksheets): 200,000+ 6th grade worksheets and activities for math, language arts, science
- [Jr High and High School Resources](https://www.123homeschool4me.com/jr-high-and-high-school-resources): 7th-12th grade worksheets, games, and activities with college prep guidance

## Core Learning Resources

- [1 Million FREE Printable Educational Worksheets](https://www.123homeschool4me.com/home-school-free-printables): 1M+ free printable worksheets for K-12 math, literacy, science, history
- [Science for Kids](https://www.123homeschool4me.com/science): 200+ science experiments, projects, and printables for toddlers-8th grade
- [History Lessons and Social Studies](https://www.123homeschool4me.com/social-studies): Hands-on history lessons with activities and worksheets for K-8 students
- [Kids Activities](https://www.123homeschool4me.com/kids-activities): Themed kids activities, crafts, slime recipes, science experiments by age
